subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model usage logging for cost tracking

question: Should OpenClaw make a core durable completed-call usage ledger the canonical accounting source, or keep spend accounting on transcript summaries, diagnostics, and plugin/external seams for now?
rationale: The evidence shows a real user need, but the boundary affects core storage policy, privacy, gateway/API contracts, plugin capability design, and future UI/CLI readers, so automation should not choose it unilaterally.

options.title: Design the core ledger first
options.body: Create a maintainer-owned first phase for a canonical SQLite-backed ledger plus transcript backfill and ledger-first readers, then let plugins consume that stable seam.

options.title: Expose a plugin seam first
options.body: Prioritize provider-scoped model-usage plugin delivery and leave durable spend ledgers to ClawHub or external plugins until native accounting requirements are clearer.

options.title: Defer native accounting
options.body: Keep transcript summaries, diagnostics, and documented external tools as the supported path while adjacent usage and auth-profile issues settle.

recommendation.title: Design the core ledger first
recommendation.body: Create a maintainer-owned first phase for a canonical SQLite-backed ledger plus transcript backfill and ledger-first readers, then let plugins consume that stable seam.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history on current usage-cost summaries, token-use docs, and the prior ledger-scope review.
